arguments.explanation: Flags transactions over $500 that were made in June, July or August 2019.
assumptions: 'Over $500' means strictly greater than $500, i.e. amount_usd_cents > 50000.
June, July and August 2019 are read as 2019-06-01 up to but not including 2019-09-01, since the data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
Amounts are compared as stored; negative amounts never exceed $500, so they are not flagged.
